Sewlip

A seasonal campaign for fashion label Sewlip, built around one dress and all the places it can take you.

Client

Chani Lipskar

Services

Social Media Marketing, Seasonal Campaign, Launch Pop Up

Year

2025

The Challenge

Sewlip wanted to prove that one dress could carry a customer through her whole day, from casual mornings to evening events. The goal was a seasonal campaign that made the piece feel versatile, aspirational, and impossible to scroll past.

What We Created

We created "Envision Yourself," a campaign built around a single dress styled across recognizable settings: daytime and night, shopping and casual, everyday and events. Each shot invited customers to picture the dress in their own life and showed just how many ways it could be worn.

The Experience

Beyond the feed, we brought the campaign to life in person. We coordinated a shopping pop up with a local coffee shop and a personal stylist, giving customers a chance to experience the brand firsthand. We also launched Sewlip's ambassador program to keep the community growing.
